mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for three consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both decline and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a restrictive policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month during a tightening cycle and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
